literal_meaning: ধন এবং প্রাণে আনন্দ/মৃত্যু (wealth and life in enjoyment/death)
figurative_meaning_en: Both wealth and health are lost or ruined
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ব্যবসায় ব্যর্থ হয়ে ধনে-প্রাণে মরা অবস্থায় পড়েছে।
এই অসুস্থতায় ধনে-প্রাণে মজা করে ফেলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He failed in business and ended up ruined in both wealth and health.
This illness has left him broke and broken in body and soul.
note: The idiom reflects common Bengali expressions of total ruin, often used in contexts of personal downfall.
